cards.definition: sprint — ciclo curto de desenvolvimento ágil
cards.example_sentence: The team commits to a set of tasks at the beginning of each sprint.

cards.definition: velocidade — quantidade de trabalho entregue por sprint
cards.example_sentence: The sprint velocity dropped because two developers are on leave.

cards.definition: backlog — lista priorizada de tarefas a desenvolver
cards.example_sentence: We refine the backlog every Wednesday to prepare for the next sprint.

cards.definition: SLO — objetivo de nível de serviço acordado
cards.example_sentence: The SLO for that service is 99.9% uptime per month.

cards.definition: incidente — evento não planejado que impacta o serviço
cards.example_sentence: The incident was caused by a misconfigured load balancer.

cards.definition: observabilidade — capacidade de medir o estado interno de um sistema
cards.example_sentence: Good observability means having logs, metrics, and traces in place.

cards.definition: Kafka — plataforma de streaming de mensagens distribuída
cards.example_sentence: Services communicate asynchronously through a Kafka message broker.

cards.definition: malha de serviços — infraestrutura para comunicação entre microsserviços
cards.example_sentence: The service mesh handles load balancing and service discovery automatically.
